title: A semi-virtual two dimensional gel electrophoresis: IF–ESI LC-MS/MS
author: Naryzhny, Zgoda, et al.

steps.title: Culture and harvest HepG2 cells
steps.instruction: Culture HepG2 cells in DMEM/F12 supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin at 5 % CO₂, 37 °C; detach cells with 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA and wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Lyse cells in urea buffer
steps.instruction: Treat 10 × 10⁶ cells (≈2 mg protein) with 100 µL lysis buffer containing 7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 4 % CHAPS, 1 % DTT, 2 % ampholytes (pH 3–10) and a protease‑inhibitor mixture.

steps.title: Prepare sample for IPG rehydration
steps.instruction: Mix 50 µL of the cell lysate (≈1000 µg protein) with rehydration buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 2 % CHAPS, 0.3 % DTT, 0.5 % IPG buffer, pH 3–11 NL, 0.001 % bromophenol blue) to a final volume of 400 µL.

steps.title: Rehydrate IPG strip
steps.instruction: Place a 24 cm Immobiline DryStrip 3–11 NL (GE Healthcare) gel‑side down onto the sample and passively rehydrate for 5 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform isoelectric focusing
steps.instruction: Run IEF on an IPGphor (GE Healthcare) with the following program: 500 V for 8 h; gradient to 1000 V over 1 h; gradient to 10000 V over 3 h; hold at 10000 V for 4 h (20 °C); then maintain at 500 V as programmed.

steps.title: Section IPG strip
steps.instruction: Cut the focused strip into 48 equal sections with scissors and transfer each section into an individual Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Reduce gel pieces
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 3 mM DTT in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate to each tube and incubate at 50 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Alkylate cysteines
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of 100 mM iodoacetamide to each tube and incubate in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Wash gel pieces (first wash)
steps.instruction: Remove liquid, add 300 µL of 50 % acetonitrile / 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, incubate 15 min, then discard the liquid.

steps.title: Wash gel pieces (second wash)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of 100 % acetonitrile, incubate 10 min or until the gel pieces appear white, then discard the liquid.

steps.title: Dry gel pieces
steps.instruction: Desiccate the gel pieces in a SpeedVac (Thermo Scientific) for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare trypsin solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ stock trypsin 1:10 in 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate to obtain the working trypsin solution.

steps.title: Digest proteins
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the diluted trypsin to each tube and incubate 4–24 h at 37 °C (overnight).

steps.title: Collect primary peptide supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from each tube to a new labeled 0.5 mL tube (peptides that have diffused out of the gel).

steps.title: Extract peptides (first extraction)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of 60 % acetonitrile / 0.1 % TFA to the gel pieces, incubate 15 min, collect the extract and combine it with the primary supernatant.

steps.title: Extract peptides (second extraction)
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 150 µL of 60 % acetonitrile / 0.1 % TFA, incubate 15 min, and combine this extract with the pooled supernatant.

steps.title: Dry combined peptide extracts
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined extracts to dryness in a SpeedVac.

steps.title: Reconstitute peptides for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried peptides in 20 µL of 0.1 % TFA.

steps.title: LC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Separate the tryptic peptides by reversed‑phase nano‑LC gradients and analyze online using an Orbitrap Q‑Exactive Plus mass spectrometer.

steps.title: Data processing and protein identification
steps.instruction: Identify and quantify proteins with Mascot 2.4.1 (Matrix Science) and calculate emPAI values.

steps.title: Compile proteoform table and map
steps.instruction: Build a table of all detected proteoforms (assigning the pI of the corresponding IPG section; treat the same protein in different sections as distinct proteoforms) and, using molecular‑weight data from NeXtProt, construct a semi‑virtual 2‑DE map.
